evidence: Read the full diff of all 9 changed files, tests included. I did not run the code or the tests.
engine/review/app/stop.go: Stop() now keys markers as <base12>-<head12>-<need> and passes one key per need. once() blocks when any key is unrecorded and records only the missing keys.

engine/review/app/unreviewed.go:112-128: a Question is returned only when review.Needs(facts[i]) is non-empty. Needs is therefore never empty when ask is true, so the empty-keys case (which would never block) cannot occur.

engine/review/fsstore/asked.go checkKey: allows lowercase letters, digits and dashes up to 64 bytes. The longest new key is 12+1+12+1+8 = 34 bytes, and the fallback need<n> is also valid, so no key is rejected.
The noDefaultKey path is unchanged apart from being passed as a one-element slice.

Risk line: item 3 is correct and sufficient. The installed stop hook can now block again in the same session when a new need appears, such as the sweeper after a sweep fires. Markers under the old <base12>-<head12> key are no longer read, so an existing session is asked once more after upgrade. No stored data format, security surface or concurrency is changed. The keys live in per-session state outside the working tree.

Tests pin the new behavior: the sweeper is asked in the same session, a need already asked is not asked again, and the Add calls are exact. The storedName helper replaces a hard-coded -1.json name and reads the stored path from the record stderr line. The git-call assertion in unreviewed_test.go is tightened to the full walk.
